name: intraday_poc-backtest
notes: The intraday BACKTEST as a walk-forward document (ADR-0027): python -m dskit.pipeline walkforward configs/run-backtest.json --asof 2026-08-25 --adapter intraday_poc. Per fold: train each symbol's LSTM on everything up to the cutoff (minus the embargo), forecast the fold's validation window, and let the select-one program pick exactly one symbol per minute — the aggregate objective is the summed realized next-bar log return of those picks. test_configs.py pins the trainer params identical to the production fit, monitor excepted. KNOWN SKEW: monitor: val_loss ships each fold's best-scoring epoch, while run-train.json (no val_rows wired) ships its last — so read total_realized as an upper bound, and hold a selection split out of the scored window before building hyperparameter search on it. The full story lives in test_configs.py's docstrings and the qhat_aapl notes.

bars.notes: Same store as run-train.json — one source of truth for both documents.

window.notes: Identical windowing to the production fit — backtest and live must consume the same features or the backtest proves nothing.

aapl_train.notes: AAPL rows up to the fold's train cut; the embargo band after it belongs to NO split.

aapl_val.notes: The fold's AAPL validation window, starting AFTER the embargo.

qhat_aapl.notes: Fresh weights every fold (expanding train window); per-epoch train/val loss lands in training_curve.json beside the fold's artifact. monitor: val_loss makes the best-scoring epoch's weights the ones that persist, not the last (ADR-0035) — it changes which weights ship, not which objective is measured. CAVEAT: aapl_val is both the monitor's selection set AND the rows total_realized scores, an optimism the objective does not correct — hold out a selection split before building hyperparameter search on it. TRADE-OFF: with a monitor, an empty val window is fatal (the engine refuses the fit as 'no val_rows are wired'), so shorten val_days if the store's tail is short rather than hunting a wiring bug. device/optimizer_params: same values and rationale as run-train.json, pinned identical by test_configs.py.

qhat_msft.notes: The MSFT twin of qhat_aapl — same knobs, same rationale, its own weights; qhat_aapl's selection-set caveat applies to msft_val.

fc_aapl.notes: One belief per AAPL validation minute — the trainer's signal predicts straight off the fitted module; a row without full feature coverage is skipped, never fabricated.

params.provenance_waiver: rows already carry their symbol; the ports are split by symbol upstream, so a port tag would duplicate the field

forecasts.notes: Both symbols' beliefs in one stream for the selector; key=symbol proves the ports stayed disjoint.

params.provenance_waiver: rows already carry their symbol; the ports are split by symbol upstream, so a port tag would duplicate the field

labeled.notes: The validation rows with their y_next labels — what realizes each pick after the fact.

select.notes: The PoC's one constraint on the PyomoSolve doorway: exactly one symbol per minute, maximize predicted next-bar return. metrics.total_realized — the summed realized log return of the picks — is the walk-forward objective.

walkforward.notes: Three expanding folds over the backfill's tail. Next-bar labels resolve in one minute, so a 1-day embargo is already generous — it exists to keep the discipline visible, not because the label needs it.

outputs.notes: Empty = ./pipeline_runs under the invoking cwd; walkforward writes one full run dir per fold plus the aggregate summary.
